description: A configured assistant: instructions, a subset of tools and knowledge, and who can use it.

fields.label: Default
fields.description: Used for new conversations when the user does not choose an agent. One agent at most.

fields.label: Read Only
fields.description: This agent can only read and answer; it has no write tools.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown to users when they choose an agent.

fields.label: Roles
fields.description: Who can use this agent. Empty: every assistant user.

fields.label: Instructions
fields.description: How this agent works: its job, tone, steps, and what to avoid. They add to the assistant's rules and never replace them.

fields.label: Allowed Tools
fields.description: One tool name per line. Empty: every tool. An agent can only have fewer tools than the assistant, never more.

fields.label: Knowledge Sources
fields.description: search_knowledge looks only in these record types (AI Knowledge Document for articles). Empty: the whole knowledge base.

name: AI Agent
